messages.subject: joining country data to a map
parts:
Hello Andy et al.,

When joining country data to a map (joinCountryData2Map()) I get the following report back:

"225 codes from your data successfully matched countries in the map
2 codes from your data failed to match with a country code in the map
29 codes from the map weren't represented in your data"

How can I easily determine the countries that failed to match and the missing countries?

Many thanks,

--

messages.author: 81b6b3d7dfea88a5
messages.subject: Re: [rworldmap group] joining country data to a map
parts:
Hi Gordon,
Adding verbose=TRUE will give you the ones from your data that failed. (I wouldn't worry about the ones in the map that are missing from your data, there are a lot of little places in there!). Just caught me before I'm heading out the door.
Best wishes,
Andy
